import hashlib, json, tempfile, shutil, datetime
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd()
out=root/'docs/evidence/pre_h03'
assert not (out/'before.json').exists(), 'No sobrescribir baseline PRE-H03'
backup=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='alabarda_pre_h03_'))
skip={'.git','.godot','__pycache__'}
files={}
docs=[]
for p in sorted(root.rglob('*')):
    rel=p.relative_to(root)
    if not p.is_file() or skip.intersection(rel.parts) or rel.as_posix().startswith('docs/evidence/pre_h03/'):
        continue
    files[rel.as_posix()]=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    if p.suffix=='.md' and 'history' not in rel.parts:
        dst=backup/rel
        dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copyfile(p,dst)
        docs.append(rel.as_posix())
out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
request=Path('C:/Users/aleja/.codex/attachments/9a490010-7dd0-40b7-826a-5edb5afccb31/Pasted text.txt')
shutil.copyfile(request,out/'request.txt')
data={'date_madrid':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone(datetime.timedelta(hours=1))).isoformat(),'files':files,'active_markdown':docs,'backup_root':str(backup),'request_sha256':hashlib.sha256(request.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
(out/'before.json').write_text(json.dumps(data,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print('SNAPSHOT files='+str(len(files))+' active_markdown='+str(len(docs))+' backup='+str(backup))
